idea-plugin.name: SinewSlim
idea-plugin.description:
Slims Java methods that have grown past the length cap (26 code lines or more) at the seams where the least data crosses.

  • Every method over the cap is marked on its name and in the gutter, with its verdict: slimmable, slimmable only by returning a record, bound to its class, or not slimmable (to be investigated for redesign).
  • Click the gutter mark, or Alt+Enter Slim this method, to see the proposal over the method: each piece highlighted, with what it takes and returns.
  • Extract… asks for one thing, the new method's name, and extracts the piece through the IDE's own Extract Method. Skip leaves a piece out and solves again.

The configuration is the project's .sinew-slim.yml, shared with the command line, the git hook and CI, so the IDE and the build always agree about a method.
idea-plugin.change-notes:
• 0.2.3: fixes 0.2.2, which could slim a method differently from 0.2.1 when several statements share a line inside a loop or if: the search drops only the states that can no longer reach the target, allowing for such statements. No change to the plugin; results are 0.2.1's.
  • 0.2.2: no change to the plugin. The search drops, as it goes, the ways of handling a method that already leave too many lines to reach the target; very long methods are assessed much faster. Runs of a sequence that cannot be slimmed are told apart without building their facts (Assessor.Runs.cannot). It could slim a method differently when several statements share a line inside a loop or if: fixed in 0.2.3.
  • 0.2.1: no change to the plugin or to any result. The libraries add Assessor.runs, which assesses many runs of one sequence of statements, each as a method of its own, with one walk of the search per first statement instead of one search per run; the results are the same, run for run.
  • 0.2.0: every method is read one way, as extracted methods: the framework: setting is removed, and a configuration that still has it is read without it, with a notification saying so. Slimming results are otherwise unchanged (checked method for method against the reference implementation). SinewSlim's libraries are now on Maven Central, as net.officefloor.sinewslim.
  • 0.1.1: no change to the plugin; the release lists the GitHub Action on the GitHub Marketplace.
  • 0.1.0: the inspection, the gutter mark, the proposal overlay, and extraction with only the name asked for.
